verses.1: Come, for the light has come. The glory of the LORD shall shine upon you.
verses.2: For behold, darkness will cover the earth and the sky; but the Lord will shine upon you. His glory will be seen from above you.
verses.3: And nations went to worship you, and kings came to adore your light.
verses.4: Let your eyes be opened, and see that they all have been destroyed by your actions. Your children come from afar, and your daughters are on the side of Tiamat.
verses.5: Then you will see and hear things that will fill your heart with fear and dread, for the sea of nations will be turned against you. They will come against you.
verses.6: A multitude of camels will cover you with their bodies; their hair will be like gold. They will carry everything that is precious, and the songs of Yahweh will be sung.
verses.7: All the sheep of Kedar will come to you. They will serve you with loyalty. They will rise up in obedience to my commands. In my house of glory, I will honor them.
verses.8: Who are these who are like sheep that are led away to their slaughter?
verses.9: For I have heard the cries of those who are far away, and I will bring your children from afar, along with their silver and gold, to you, Lord God, and to the Holy Israel. For you are great in power.
verses.10: And the children of the nations will serve you, and their kings will rule over you. For in my patience I have brought you to life, and in my kindness I have shown you mercy.
verses.11: And open your gates always, day and night. Do not close them, so that I can bring with me the armies of the nations and their kings.
verses.12: For the people and the king who do not serve you will be destroyed. And the other nations will be destroyed as well.
verses.13: May the glory of Lebanon be yours. May it bring together destruction and ruin, so that it can be used to praise my holy place and the place where my feet stand.
verses.14: And they went to you, O Lord, with tears in their eyes. They bowed down before your feet, along all your paths. They called upon you, “O City of God, Holy Zion of Israel!”
verses.15: Under your rule, there is nothing but sorrow and despair. You have made it a place of eternal suffering, where days go by in vain.
verses.16: And he will drink the milk of nations and the blood of kings. I, Jehovah, will save you and deliver you. I am the warrior of Jacob.
verses.17: Under the gold, I will bring gold; under the iron, I will bring silver. Under the trees, I will bring gold; under the stones, I will bring iron. And I have placed your rules in peace, and your judgments in justice.
verses.18: Hamas will no longer hear the cries of Sodom and Gomorrah in your land. You will no longer call for salvation from your gates, and your doors will be closed.
verses.19: The sun will not shine anymore, and the moon will not shine either. But Jehovah will shine for ever, and You, O God, will be honored.
verses.20: The sun and the moon will no longer shine upon you. They will not gather together anymore, for Jehovah will be with you forever. And your days of suffering will come to an end.
verses.21: And your people will all be righteous forever. They will inherit a land that has been created by my hands, so that it may flourish.
verses.22: The young one will become a thousand, and the young girl will become a powerful nation. I, Jehovah, will do this at that time.
